subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Three-Phase Power
description: Learn Three-Phase Power in one minute.

hook.text: Factories don't use single-phase power. They need three-phase for heavy loads.

buildup.text: Three AC waves, each 120 degrees apart, share the same wires.

discovery.text: The three waves always sum to a constant — power delivery is perfectly smooth.

twist.text: Three-phase delivers 73% more power than single-phase with the same copper.

climax.text: Every industrial motor, data center, and power line uses three-phase today.

punchline.text: Three waves beat one — smoother, cheaper, and more powerful.

quiz.question: Why does three-phase power deliver smoother energy?
options: The voltage is three times higher than single-phase
Three waves offset by 120 degrees always sum to a constant
Three-phase uses thicker wires that reduce resistance
